cases.title: Clicking an available seat marks it as selected and updates count
cases.description: Clicking on any available seat (without the occupied class) marks it as selected, and the selected seat count updates in the element with data-testid="selected-count".

cases.title: Selecting a movie updates the movie dropdown and price
cases.description: Selecting a movie from the dropdown (data-testid="movie-select"), where each option has a value representing the ticket price, correctly sets the movie price used for calculations.

cases.title: Total price is calculated correctly based on selected seats and movie price
cases.description: The total price, shown in the element with data-testid="total-price", is calculated as the number of selected seats multiplied by the selected movie’s price.

cases.title: Occupied seats are not selectable and do not affect count or price
cases.description: Seats marked as occupied must not be selectable and should not affect the selected seat count or total price.

cases.title: Changing the selected movie updates total price dynamically
cases.description: Changing the selected movie at any time updates the total price accordingly based on the new movie price and current selected seat count.

cases.title: Select a movie from the dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that users can select a movie from the dropdown menu (e.g., 'The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', and 'No Country for Old Men ($9)', each identified by a specific data-testid) and the price updates accordingly.

cases.title: Toggle seat selection status and update localStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat toggles its selection status, visually marks the seat as selected, and stores its index in localStorage.

cases.title: Dynamically update seat count and total price
cases.description: Verify that the seat count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price") are dynamically updated based on the number of selected seats and the chosen movie's price.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected or included in the calculation.

cases.title: Deselect previously selected seats
cases.description: Verify that users can deselect previously selected seats by clicking on them again, and the UI along with localStorage updates accordingly.

cases.title: Restore selected seats and movie from localStorage on load
cases.description: Verify that when local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the system marks corresponding seats with the 'selected' class and sets the movie dropdown to the correct option.

cases.title: Default state when localStorage is empty on load
cases.description: Verify that when local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the dropdown defaults to the first movie option 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Select Movie Sets Ticket Price
cases.description: Verify that when the user selects a movie from the dropdown menu with data-testid 'movie-select', the ticket price is set according to the selected movie's value.

cases.title: Toggle Available Seat Selection
cases.description: Verify that as the user clicks on available seats (those without the 'occupied' class) within the seating area, the system toggles the 'selected' class on the clicked seat.

cases.title: Update Selected Seat Count Display
cases.description: Verify that the count of selected seats, displayed with data-testid 'selected-count', updates to reflect the current number of seats with the 'selected' class.

cases.title: Calculate Total Price
cases.description: Verify that the total price, displayed with data-testid 'total-price', is calculated as the product of the number of selected seats and the current ticket price.

cases.title: Deselect Seat Decreases Count and Total Price
cases.description: Verify that if a user deselects a seat by clicking on it again, the count and total price decrease accordingly.

cases.title: Change Movie Updates Total Price Maintaining Seat Count
cases.description: Verify that if the user changes the movie selection after selecting seats, the total price updates based on the new ticket price while maintaining the count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent Selection of Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that the system prevents users from selecting seats marked as 'occupied'.

cases.title: Verify seat status legends presence
cases.description: Verify that legends indicating the status of each seat (such as available, selected, and occupied) are present with their corresponding data-testid attributes to help users understand seat states.

cases.title: Verify occupied seats are non-interactive
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as occupied are non-interactive and clearly marked to prevent selection when clicked.

cases.title: Verify available seats selection toggle
cases.description: Verify that available seats can be clicked to toggle their selection status.

cases.title: Verify count and price update on seat selection or deselection
cases.description: Verify that when users select or deselect seats, the count of selected seats and the total price are updated accordingly.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and their explicit behaviors have been thoroughly checked. The proposed test cases cover every normal, boundary, and state-restoration behavior described across the requirements without missing any explicitly stated operational paths or introducing speculative scenarios.
All requirements and their explicit scenarios are fully covered by the provided test cases without any blockers or missing gaps.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 contains multiple distinct behaviors: interacting with seat map and movie dropdown to update total price, clicking available seat to mark as selected, updating selected seat count in data-testid="selected-count", selecting a movie from data-testid="movie-select" where options have price values, calculating total price in data-testid="total-price" as selected seats multiplied by movie price, preventing occupied seats from being selectable and affecting count/price, and updating total price when changing movie selection. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 contains multiple distinct behaviors: selecting a movie from dropdown with specified options, updating price upon movie selection, toggling seat selection status on click, visually marking selected seats and storing indices in localStorage, dynamically updating seat count and total price, preventing occupied seats from selection or calculation, and deselecting previously selected seats by clicking again with UI and localStorage update. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 contains multiple distinct behaviors: retrieving and applying previously selected seats and movie selection from local storage on page load, marking seats with 'selected' class based on 'selectedSeats' keys, setting movie dropdown based on 'selectedMovieIndex', and defaulting to no selected seats and first movie option ('The Big Lebowski ($10)') when local storage values are absent. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 contains multiple distinct behaviors: dynamically displaying selected seat count and total price, setting ticket price from data-testid 'movie-select' value, toggling 'selected' class on clicked available seats, updating 'selected-count' display, calculating 'total-price' as product of selected seats and ticket price, decreasing count and total price upon seat deselection, updating total price while maintaining seat count when changing movie after seat selection, and preventing selection of 'occupied' seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 contains multiple distinct behaviors: distinguishing seat statuses through legends with data-testid attributes, marking occupied seats as non-interactive to prevent selection, allowing available seats to be clicked for selection toggling, and updating selected seat count and total price upon seat selection or deselection.
